'''Grand Admiral Visage The Power of the Lightside''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Grand Admiral Visage]]
* '''Published:''' 5 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' The Power of the Lightside
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 The Power of the Lightside Visage L.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

From the maker of "The power of the Darkside" comes The Power of the Lightside. The power is a deck devoted to The Lightside of the Force.
This deck was designed and tested against THE POWER OF THE DARKSIDE and at various tournaments. Thank You for choosing the LIGHTSIDE.

The published list has 139 cards.

== Strategy ==

Yes, just like the POWER OF THE DARKSIDE there is no predetermind strategy for this deck. Again this is a guide of great cards that have worked for me in the past and that will work for you.
Please let me know what you think of this deck.


Grand Admiral Visage
